comparison: SELECT DISTINCT 결과 행 집합과 gold 행 집합의 완전 일치

pack_lookup.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE m.cr = :anchor

disposition_pack.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM disposition d JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

full_chain.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting, s.clause FROM disposition d JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN cr_modifies_section c ON c.cr = d.target JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND s.clause IS NOT NULL

revision_chain.sql: WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS ( SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id) SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number FROM later JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

clause_history.sql: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number FROM cr_modifies_section c JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = c.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = c.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = c.cr JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE c.section_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

pack_origin.sql: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label FROM pack_member m JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

pack_lookup_empty.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE m.cr = :anchor

clause_neighbours.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.clause, o.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number FROM cr_modifies_section cx JOIN document x ON x.id = cx.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = cx.section_id JOIN cr_modifies_section co ON co.section_id = s.id JOIN document o ON o.id = co.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = o.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = o.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE cx.cr = :anchor AND o.id <> :anchor AND x.target_release = s.release AND o.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

first_change.sql: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, s.spec, s.clause FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_modifies_section c ON c.cr = m.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cr_modifies_section c2 JOIN document d2 ON d2.id = c2.cr JOIN cr_in_pack m2 ON m2.cr = c2.cr JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id = m2.pack_id WHERE c2.section_id = s.id AND d2.target_release = s.release AND p2.tsg_number < p.tsg_number)

previous_pack.sql: WITH touched AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.id AS sid, s.spec, s.clause, s.release, p.tsg_number AS t FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_modifies_section c ON c.cr = m.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'), prev AS ( SELECT t.sid, t.spec, t.clause, p2.pack_number, p2.tsg_meeting, p2.tsg_number FROM touched t JOIN cr_modifies_section c2 ON c2.section_id = t.sid JOIN document d2 ON d2.id = c2.cr JOIN cr_in_pack m2 ON m2.cr = c2.cr JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id = m2.pack_id WHERE d2.target_release = t.release AND p2.tsg_number < t.t) SELECT DISTINCT spec, clause, pack_number, tsg_meeting FROM prev WHERE tsg_number = (SELECT max(q.tsg_number) FROM prev q WHERE q.sid = prev.sid)
